units.source_text: 每当阿雪背着的弟弟啼哭的时候，阿雪只好离开教室。

en.t: Whenever the little brother A-Xue carried on her back began to cry, she had no choice but to leave the classroom.

units.source_text: 十分钟的课间休息，她要给弟弟换尿布，还得去要奶。

en.t: During the ten-minute recess, she had to change her little brother's diaper and also go ask for milk.
